card1.heading: Welcome to GraceChords.
card1.body: Songs, setlists, and Scripture — whatever worship looks like for you today.

card2.heading: Ready for the platform.
card2.body: Transpose to any key and read it clean under stage lights. Start a Live Session to keep the whole team on the same song, or share a chord sheet as a PDF or image in the key you're playing.

card3.heading: Meditate on the Word.
card3.body: The M'Cheyne reading plan walks you through the whole Bible in a year, four passages a day. Download your favorite translation for offline use.
